title: 第二十三章 朝堂众臣相第二十四章 陆俊峰 我不玩了我想回家
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
此世当真有仙神不成？
这些人真的可以长生不老么？
他们真的拥有那么强大的力量么？
他们远渡重洋，来到大夏的目的是什么？
陛下对于这些人的态度又是什么？
如何奖励其功劳？该许之什么位置？
……
石头落入平静的湖面，泛起阵阵涟漪。
盛州的消息传回，便是彻底坐实了陆俊峰一行人的身份和能力。
万千民众的眼睛是不会说谎的，旱灾总归是解了。
他们自证成功了。
掌握天时，可随意行雨，这可不是简单说说的能力。
他们并非欺世盗名之徒，而是货真价实的世外仙真。现实摆在这里，纵使是再难以想象，群臣也需要接受。
现在需要担心的已经不是陛下追求丹药方士，追求长生不老了。
而是这些超出世俗理解之人的出现，将会对大夏产生怎样的影响，对于他们这些管理者产生怎样的影响。
各种各样的问题同样也在脑中浮现。
但是此刻却无人出声。
因为大家知道，谢苍荣想听的不是疑问，而是他们的立场和谏言。
过了一会儿，一位官职不高的文官试探性地出言道：“陛下……下雨或有偶然，是否需要再试探一番，摸清这些人的底细。”
“不妥！”

上次朝会还谏言谢苍荣不要轻信方士的云昭，这次却站出来反对道：“陛下，试探一次足矣。能者皆有傲骨，可试之不可辱之，反反复复又将圣言置于何地？无论如何，既然他们求来了雨，便是有功，有功当赏。否则，恐失我大朝气度。”
一武将不住冷哼了声：“陛下，那些人纵是真有能耐，但也太傲了！视我等如无物，目无君上！若是真对其礼遇有加，还不知道要提出何等非分之求呢！”
宁伯兴却是摇了摇头，原本粗莽的汉子此刻却颇为正经道：“陛下，臣以为，该赏则赏，该罚则罚。如今他们确实立了功，便是给他们赏，真若恃才傲物犯了我大夏律法，再罚也不迟。”
柳秉玄身侧的一个文官站出来说道：“陛下，臣以为该想方设法将修士修行法门、玄奇神通引入我朝，供臣民修行，以壮我国力。”
此言一出，朝堂骤然静了一瞬！
有些人不由自主地吸了口气，眼中饱含热切。
这些修士看着挺年轻的，他们的法术能不能学呢？
这是很重要的问题。
归根结底，高居庙堂者，亦为血肉之躯，难逃欲望纠缠。谁不想掌控超凡伟力？谁不想长生不死呢？
“不可！”
下一瞬，又一面容严肃的文官站出来：“陛下！非我族类，其心必异！咱们现在都不知道这些修士的底细，如何能委以重任？其跨海而来必当有所图谋，如若其包含祸心，又该当如何？”
content_en:
Are there really immortals and gods in this world?
Can these people really live forever?
Do they really have that much power?
What is their purpose of crossing the ocean and coming to Daxia?
What is His Majesty's attitude towards these people?
How to reward its contribution? What position should it be given?
…
The stone fell into the calm lake, causing ripples.
The news coming back from Shengzhou completely confirmed the identity and abilities of Lu Junfeng and his party.
The eyes of thousands of people cannot lie, and the drought has finally been resolved.
They proved themselves successful.
The ability to control the weather and make it rain at will is not something you can simply talk about.
They are not deceptive people, but genuine immortals from the world. The reality is here, even if it is unimaginable, the ministers still need to accept it.
What we need to worry about now is no longer His Majesty's pursuit of elixirs and alchemists and his pursuit of immortality.
But what kind of impact will the appearance of these people who are beyond worldly understanding have on Daxia and what kind of impact will it have on them, the managers.
Various questions also come to mind.
But no one said anything at this moment.
Because everyone knows that what Xie Cangrong wants to hear is not questions, but their positions and advice.
After a while, a civil servant with a low official position said tentatively: "Your Majesty... maybe it rains or there is an accident, do you need to test again to find out the details of these people?"
"Inappropriate!"
Yun Zhao, who had advised Xie Cangrong not to trust the alchemists in the last court meeting, stood up and objected this time: "Your Majesty, one test is enough. All capable people have pride, and they cannot be insulted if they are tested. Where do they put the holy words over and over again? In any case, since they have prayed for rain, they have achieved merit, and they should be rewarded for their merit. Otherwise, I may lose my great magnanimity."
A military general couldn't help but snorted coldly: "Your Majesty, even though those people are really capable, they are too arrogant! They treat me like nothing, and they have no superiority! If they really treat them with courtesy, I don't know what kind of undue demands they will make!"
Ning Boxing shook his head. The originally rude man now said quite seriously: "Your Majesty, I believe that rewards should be rewarded and punishments should be punished. Now that they have indeed made meritorious service, they will be rewarded. If they really violate the laws of Daxia by relying on their talent and arrogance, it will not be too late to punish them."
A civil servant next to Liu Bingxuan stood up and said: "Your Majesty, I think we should find ways to introduce monks' practice methods and mysterious magical powers into our court for the practice of our subjects in order to strengthen our country."
As soon as these words came out, the court suddenly fell silent for a moment!
Some people took a breath involuntarily, their eyes full of eagerness.
These monks look quite young. Can they learn their magic?
This is a very important question.
In the final analysis, those who live in temples are also made of flesh and blood and cannot escape the entanglement of desires. Who doesn’t want to control extraordinary power? Who doesn't want to live forever?
"No!"
The next moment, another civil official with a serious face stood up: "Your Majesty! If they are not of my race, they must have different intentions! We don't know the details of these monks now, how can we entrust them with important tasks? They must have a purpose when they come across the sea. What if they have evil intentions?"
